categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou GYZ Electronic Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, design, manufacturing, and sales of precision electronic components, focusing on optical modules for smartphones (CCM) and voice coil motors (VCM). The company also actively develops automotive electronics, including chassis control braking systems and steering components, and electronic ceramics such as MLCC and DPC products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing technologies including stamping, electroplating, injection molding, SMT, chip packaging, and assembly. It has proprietary integrated chip molding (CMI) technology with multiple generations of products, including HD-CMI with ceramic substrates. The production also involves automated winding, high-precision tooling, and in-house developed SMT equipment, supporting high precision and integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international smartphone brands and component manufacturers such as Sunny Optical, New Thinking Group, TDK, and Luxshare Precision. The end markets cover consumer electronics, especially smartphones, automotive electronics for traditional and new energy vehicles, and industrial applications for electronic ceramics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and manufacturing facilities in Suzhou and Chizhou. It serves domestic markets extensively and exports a smaller portion of products internationally. The automotive and electronic ceramics markets are expanding with both domestic and international customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: GYZ Electronic operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design and manufacturing of precision electronic components and integrated modules supplied to downstream smartphone and automotive manufacturers. It also engages in upstream material processing such as electroplating and stamping.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in optical modules, automotive electronics, and electronic ceramics. It invests heavily in R&D (about 19% of revenue), focusing on advancing CMI technology, expanding MLCC and DPC product lines, and developing integrated automotive control systems. It emphasizes automation, high integration, and proprietary equipment development to maintain technological leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized precision electronic components and integrated modules to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in consumer electronics and automotive sectors. The company also earns income from mold development and electroplating services. MLCC products are sold via a combination of direct and distributor channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: GYZ Electronic is a leading domestic supplier in the precision electronic components sector, competing with international firms like TDK, Mitsumi, Alps, and domestic peers such as Luxshare Precision. It holds a technological edge with proprietary CMI products and is expanding its footprint in automotive electronics and electronic ceramics to strengthen its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 560.8 million, a 6.83% increase year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 123.9 million, slightly improved from the previous year. Total assets were about RMB 1.53 billion, with a decrease in equity due to accumulated losses. The company is in a growth phase, investing heavily in new product lines and capacity expansion, particularly in MLCC and automotive electronics.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: GYZ Electronic emphasizes high-precision, integrated electronic components with advanced proprietary technologies such as multi-generation CMI products featuring ceramic substrates, which reduce assembly complexity and cost for customers. Its vertically integrated manufacturing and in-house equipment development provide cost advantages and product quality leadership. The company also offers customized solutions and maintains strong collaborative relationships with leading OEMs to meet evolving market demands.
